purpose: Compiled memory and exact host-equivalence evidence for the sandbox stack fix; no absolute peak-SP or smoothness claim.

compiledFrames.method: Read unchanged ROM machine prologues and corresponding call-site argument/register pushes.
compiledFrames.chainScope: Static feasible chain relative to toronto_update entry; includes that chain's native locals, arguments, return addresses and bank-call pushes. Engine callers and interrupts are additional. This is not an observed minimum SP or a whole-game stack maximum.
compiledFrames.branchIsolation: Instant, dwell and held-arrival pose/body scratch is allocated only inside its private branch helper; normal range traversal no longer retains those three19-byte pairs.
compiledFrames.heldAndRetreat: Held automatic scratch totals are unchanged with a small extra private call frame; held queries do not descend into normal travel. Retreat extent retains its58-byte frame and its nested future sweep receives the same57-byte reduction.

losslessUiPacking.textEncoding: 18 rows of20 six-bit glyphs:15 bytes per row; empty glyph63.
losslessUiPacking.atlasEncoding: 172 ten-bit dictionary IDs:215 bytes; empty1023; shared union remains270 bytes.
losslessUiPacking.logicalStatePreserved: Glyphs, cache misses/repaints, atlas dictionary IDs and upload-slot order, all22 actor hidden flags and menu/map state.

compiledStaticMemory.qualification: Static separation from heap end to stack origin; not a measured maximum stack requirement.

oldTramDifferential.scope: Archived pre-refactor tram plus independent uncached motion reference versus shallow tram plus current exact motion cache. Both variants preserve the same gameplay. Source-change guard covered the two tram files while disjoint UI code, excluded from the composed engine, was packed concurrently.

hostValidation.qualification: Host sanitizers and adapters prove scoped logic and state equality; native CPU timing, interrupt high-water and cartridge execution require separate evidence.

nativeInitializedProbeQualification: Only the first 13 initialized printer bytes, hex 8833020004000100e47f000000, are invariant. The remaining 11 script bytes may legitimately change after scene return; the entire 24-byte packet is not immutable. See NATIVE_SANDBOX_STABLE.json for the separate replacement ROM's observations.
gameplayScope: No reduction in pedestrian or vehicle counts, update cadence, art, OAM limits, physics, timetable, query validation or save format.
